upsertSlices.label: Semirandom coloring: where algorithms beat hardness
upsertSlices.task: A planted model with adversarial additions and explicitly conditional low-density hardness.
assumptions: The plot is a fixed-k density reference, not a claim that every variable-k threshold equals 1 or1/2. Exact n,k,ε conditions are beside the points. Green is sufficient density; red is conditional hardness below its boundary.

axis.label: See scoped figure panels; incompatible objectives have separate axes

results.guarantee: Certify an optimal k-coloring with high probability
results.notes: For fixed k and large n the log term dominates. Marker1 is only a limiting normalized density. Exact k dependence is retained, and C₀ is not numerically instantiated.

results.guarantee: No polynomial-time k-coloring with high probability unless NP⊆RP
results.notes: The fixed-k normalized boundary approaches(1−ε)/2. This is not an information-theoretic impossibility: a planted coloring exists.
